scheduled_journals.note: This app instantiates CreateBook(Personal) scheduled_income / scheduled_spend. ApplyEvent marks JournalEntry.kind from the rule-id prefix. A future-dated spend_cash is still an actual and is refused here. forecast_* is the bank-balance-predictor sibling. Payroll and envelope kinds are not invented. Recurrence rules stay in the calendar; each occurrence is a dated row.

calendar_oauth.note: Live calendar OAuth (Google Calendar, Outlook, or similar) is leftover on #163. This scaffold accepts a normalized dated occurrence, not a provider SDK and not an rrule expander in the journal.

grant_path.note: first-party Connect apps call ConnectApiUrl with a verified Connect access token (authorization_code or client_credentials against WorkOS Connect). Membership still required. A Connect token never takes RATIO_DEMO_OPEN and never matches org:{id}. leftover #22: WorkOS dashboard registration, DEMO_MEMBERS naming a live WorkOS sub, unused Cognito CloudFormation resources.
